collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DEPARTURES AND EXILE (DEP-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Leaving and being left: moving huts, short journeys, visitors going home, goodbyes done well and badly, homesickness, and the rare person who sails away for good. Choosing to leave is never a rejection of one's people, and choosing to stay is never a failure.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A traveler asks a villager who has never wanted to leave whether they ever think of it: say so, or think about it properly.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A traveler passing through the village asks (name1) a question (he/she) has never been asked before: "Have you ever thought of leaving? Seeing other places?" (name1) has to think about it. (He/she) has lived here (his/her) whole life. (He/she) has never wanted to go anywhere else. Is that strange?

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) thinks about it all evening. (He/she) imagines other beaches, other villages, other fires. They sound interesting. (He/she) doesn't want to go to any of them. In the morning (he/she) tells the traveler, "I thought about it. I'm staying." The traveler nods as if that's a perfectly good answer. It is.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "No," says (name1). "I like it here." The traveler looks a little surprised, then smiles. "That sounds nice." "It is," says (name1). The traveler leaves the next morning to see somewhere else. (name1) goes fishing in the same spot (he/she) has fished for twenty years, and catches the same kind of fish, and is perfectly happy.
